Rivals already hold the two strongest rows: Dealectric under-$1,000 has the P1800 + 600 W at $718.20 and Dealectric under-$3,000 has the R3500 + SP039 at $1,753.93, ships now. decides: Confirms the ALLPOWERS R3500 + SP039 600 W as the ships-now pick: $1,753.93 through the link is the lowest price per Wh of any 600 W-and-up kit ($0.55) and $845.07 under StormWatts' Nov 8 price for the EcoFlow 640 W kit, which was a late-November ship. For a shopper who can wait, the ALLPOWERS R2500 V2 + SP039 at $1,080.69 (1,920 Wh, dispatch Dec 11) undercuts both ABOK cards.
